source_read: https://www.wagamama.com/menu downloaded fresh on 8 Oct (menu now '07/10/2026 - UK - main website') AND the earlier saved copy of the 6 Oct page (menu '17/06/2026 - UK - main website') that data/source/wagamama was built from
notes: Extraction is faithful: an independent reader of the page payload matches all 136 name-matched published dishes (9 nutrient values incl. kJ + 14 allergens with cereals/nuts) against the 6 Oct copy, 0 differences. BUT the live site changed on 7 Oct: 10 dishes gone, 22 new, 10 changed (tantanmen beef brisket ramen 713->632 kcal, grilled chicken ramen 456->498, gochujang pork belly ramen 949->920 / 1003->950, chilli chicken ramen 541->589, yasai katsu curry, hot yasai katsu curry, kids yasai katsu x2, Korean barbecue brisket bao; allergens changed on tantanmen, grilled chicken ramen and gochujang pork belly ramen). Those 20 are held back (STALE_ON_LIVE_PAGE in tools/uk_extract/wagamama.py) until the script's section table is updated and the new page extracted. Also held back: 7 dishes whose printed kJ and kcal disagree by more than 7% (Buldak fire wings, Gochujang tamarind pork ribs, Tonkatsu pork bao bun, Katsu udon, 3 bao nuts). Not done: a full refresh to the new menu (needs S, GF_SAME_AS, expected counts re-reviewed).
